text:
incbot: Pager: HIGH error rate and timeouts observed for egress traffic from Customer Dovetail (private VPC) to third-party embeddings API. Severity: P2. Affected: API calls to embeddings.redhost.example (outbound).

jess_oncall: Acked. I'm on it. Paging net and SRE.

ryan_netops: Looking. Any recent config changes in the privnet? ACLs / SGs?

sam_se: Dovetail reported timeouts ~16:34 UTC, started after a routine security group cleanup that finished ~16:30. Could be related.

maya_sre: I'm seeing 502/504 from our egress proxy logs and NLB healthchecks failing for the tenant's NLB swarm:
```
[2026-03-17T16:35:12Z] target/10.10.44.12 HTTP_1xx 502
[2026-03-17T16:35:22Z] target/10.10.44.13 TCP_CONNECTION_RESET
HealthCheck: failed 3/3 consecutive
```

jess_oncall: @ryan_netops can you confirm if the tenant's security group lost outbound 443 earlier?

ryan_netops: Running quick check.
`aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-0abcde12345 --query 'IpPermissions'`
Found: outbound rules show 0.0.0.0/0 tcp 443 missing. There is a recent revoke event in CloudTrail at 2026-03-17T16:29:54Z by automation-maintenance-role.

ana_prod: (typo) ana_prod: Customer-facing timeline: Dovetail reports degraded embeddings on webhooks. They are on Dedicated reserved pool but private VPC egress through our shared NAT/Egress Proxy. Impact: ~60% of embedding requests failing.

lucas_csm: I've messaged the Dovetail ops contact: "We're investigating; temporary mitigation in progress. Will update in 15 min." They are concerned about delayed job processing.

maya_sre: Short-term mitigation plan: 1) Re-open outbound 443 on tenant SG 2) Add temporary route to force egress via shared Egress Proxy (bypass NLB to unhealthy targets) 3) Warm up proxy connections and monitor.

ryan_netops: Reauthorizing SG egress now:
`aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0abcde12345 --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0`

deploy_bot: runbook:privnet-egress -> step 3 (reroute to shared-egress-proxy) triggered by jess_oncall.

jess_oncall: Executed step 3 (added route table override for tenant subnet -> nat-eni-zzzz). Confirming traffic shift.

sam_se: After route change, I see connections from tenant nodes to proxy established. Proxy logs show retries succeeded:
```
[16:38:05] tenant:dovetail req_id=aa12 status=200 latency=120ms
[16:38:10] tenant:dovetail req_id=aa13 status=200 latency=98ms
```

maya_sre: NLB health checks still failing for original target group. We'll keep it isolated to avoid flapping; can we mark tenant's NLB as draining?

ryan_netops: Putting NLB target group into draining for Dovetail targets. `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:... --targets Id=ip-10.10.44.12`

ana_prod: ana_prod: Customer impact note -> "Embeddings requests were failing for ~18 minutes between 16:30–16:48 UTC, root cause: unintended security group egress removal during maintenance. Temporary mitigation: reroute to shared egress proxy. Permanent: update maintenance ACLs and add pre-checks."

lucas_csm: Dovetail is satisfied with temporary mitigation, requests status page update. They want a postmortem.

maya_sre: Collecting artifacts for postmortem: CloudTrail revoke event, security group state diff, NLB healthcheck logs, proxy access logs. Saving to incident bucket: s3://incidents/6932104321-artifacts (will attach link when ready).

jess_oncall: Handing off to ryan_netops for follow-up and config hardening. I'm pausing pager; if errors reappear escalate back. Next oncall: ryan_netops.

ryan_netops: Taking over. Next steps: 1) Reconcile automation-maintenance-role policy to prevent accidental SG revokes 2) Add preflight check to maintenance job to verify essential egress ports 3) Schedule a CR with Dovetail for a GRACEFUL NLB failover test.

deploy_bot: incident status updated -> mitigation in place, monitoring. Incident marked P2 - customer impact but degraded functionality.

lucas_csm: Will coordinate postmortem timeline and get customer stakeholder availability. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

incbot: Incident 6932104321 status: Mitigated -> monitoring. Page closed by jess_oncall at 2026-03-17T16:50:00Z.

jess_oncall: Closing notes: root cause = maintenance automation removed egress 443 from tenant SG. Mitigation = reauthorize SG + reroute to shared proxy + drain NLB. Action items: automation policy fix (ryan), add preflight checks (maya), postmortem + customer RCA (ana & lucas).
